items.q: Does this work on a phone?
items.a: Yes. Every course is fully responsive and works on any modern browser on any device. Most cooks take it on their phone during prep.
All core courses are offered in English and Spanish. Food Handler is additionally available in Mandarin, Vietnamese, and Korean.

items.q: Can I integrate with my HRIS?
items.a: Yes — on the business plan. We offer SCIM-based user provisioning and SSO through Okta, Google Workspace, and Azure AD. Completion data can also be pushed to your LMS via SCORM 2004 or xAPI.
